purpose: Teach: てっきり/間抜け/漫才/王女/並木/白馬/舞う/過敏

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、てっきり、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、忙しい、絶対、と、思った?本気で
lines.en: Sho — did you really think Mei-sis was too busy to spend time with you?
lines.style: Warm, teasing lilt. Lean-in intimacy. Genuine reassurance under the playful question. Soft pace, like she's already decided he doesn't believe it anyway.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、間抜けな、絶対、ミス、絶対、テストで、絶対、しちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I totally messed up that test. Made a really dumb mistake.
lines.style: Small voice, matter-of-fact. A quiet admission without drama. Glance downward — not shame, just honesty. Very still.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 土曜日の、本気で、絶対、漫才番組、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、翔くんと、絶対、見たいわ
lines.en: There's a comedy show on Saturday. I'd really like to watch it with you, Sho.
lines.style: Genuine excitement held gently. Not loud, but alive. The offer is sincere — she's already imagining it. Slightly lifted tone on the invitation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、絵本の王女、絶対、好きでしょ
lines.en: Do you still like those picture-book princesses, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Curious, observant. Not testing — genuinely wondering if something he noticed still holds true. Soft and searching, like he's paying attention to her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、並木道、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、翔くんと、絶対、歩きたいわ
lines.en: I'd love to walk with you through the tree-lined path in the park, Sho.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful. Slow, deliberate pacing. Like she's painting the picture as she speaks. Breathiness on the edges. A small wish, gently held.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、白馬、絶対、ぼく、絶対、絵で、絶対、描いたよ
lines.en: I drew a white horse for you. In a picture.
lines.style: Quiet pride, the unselfconscious kind. Not bragging — offering something he made with care. Pause before speaking, like he's checking her reaction already.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 花びらが、本気で、絶対、舞うように、絶対、降ってきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: The petals came down like they were dancing, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, almost reverie. Breathing space between words. Like she's seeing it again as she speaks. Trailing off with wonder — the moment is more real than the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、花粉に、絶対、過敏に、絶対、反応するんだ
lines.en: I react really strongly to pollen, though. So I sneeze a lot.
lines.style: Small laugh buried under the confession. Matter-of-fact, slightly self-aware. He's noticed her struggles — she's admitting the mundane truth underneath the magic.
